The same rates appear in MD&A 'Analysis of Charge-offs', Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 table ('annualized ratio of net charge-offs to average loans outstanding'): Personal loans average $26,183,468K, net charge-offs $171,015K, ratio 2.62%; Student loans average $15,971,158K, net charge-offs $24,266K, ratio 0.61%
net_charge_off_rates_q2_2026.table_footnote_quote: Excludes the impact of delinquent personal loan sales during the quarter. These loans were sold prior to charge-off during each respective quarter and otherwise would have been charged off as of the quarter-end consistent with our policy.

notes: The filing prints SoFi amounts in THOUSANDS ('(In Thousands, Except for Share Data)'; Note 4 prints e.g. Student loans 16,920,564); converted here to $ millions by dividing by 1,000. Note 4 balances are inclusive of fair market value adjustments and accrued interest. Student loans footnote (2): "Includes $3,667,582 and $4,410,038 of student loans covered by financial guarantees" (thousands). Personal loans footnote (1): "Includes loans originated as part of the loan platform business on behalf of third party partners." Six-month ratios: personal 2.79%, student 0.63%. The MD&A bullet says the personal 2.62% includes the impact of delinquency sales, while the charge-off table footnote (4) says the ratio excludes it; both quoted verbatim, not reconciled here.
